name: mold
description: mdlib ("mold") is a molecular dynamics library: readers for common trajectory and structure formats (PDB, GRO, XYZ, XTC, TRR, DCD), a molecule query/filter language, and an OpenGL renderer for space-fill, licorice, ribbon, and cartoon representations.

Overlay port. mdlib has no upstream registry port and ships no install rules, so find_package(mold CONFIG REQUIRED) cannot succeed against it as-is. add-install-rules.patch adds the install/export logic plus a generated moldConfig.cmake, producing a mold::mdlib target and matching the find_package(<pkg> CONFIG REQUIRED) + namespaced-target pattern used across OpenSpace dependencies.
mdlib supports x86-64 and ARM64 (NEON via SIMDe abstraction).
